learning_outcomes.text: To have knowledge about CAD, CAM systems.
To learn drawing techniques used in CAM programs.
To learn drawing techniques used in CAM programs.
To be able to create part machining programs for CNC machines.
To be able to perform applications on CNC machines.

syllabus_topics: 2D drawing commands: line, circle, rectangle, arc, etc.
2D drawing editing commands: copy, array, trim, etc., dimensioning.
Tool selection, creation of cutting tool position information.
Defining cutting parameters, approach, plunge, and retraction of the cutting tool to the workpiece.
Extrude, revolve, extrude cut, etc. commands.
Editing 3D models: copy, array, chamfer, fillet, etc. commands.
Profiling, grooving, pocketing, surfacing, drilling, and machining methods for prismatic parts.
Facing, profiling, grooving, drilling, internal and external threading operations for cylindrical parts.
Cutting tool coating technology, classification of cutting tool materials and ISO code keys for inserts.
Machining parts on CNC machines with CAM operations prepared for 3, 4 and multi-axes, CAM applications.
Data transfer to CNC lathe and milling machine control panels and definition of the procedure, defining the workpiece zero point on the CNC machine and machining parts.
assessment_rules: The assessment is based on a midterm exam weighted 50% and a final exam weighted 50%. The dates for the midterm and final exams are determined by the University Senate and announced in the academic calendar.
